key_idea: The dihedral group only produces rotations of the cyclic sequence and of its reversal, so the test sequence must be a contiguous cyclic run of d read forwards or backwards.
sketch: Since labels are a permutation, find the unique position of t[0] in d and compare t against d walking clockwise and walking counter-clockwise with wraparound; answer 1 if either matches. O(n). Pitfalls: wraparound modulo n, and m = 1 is always 1.
